name: Cody Chovancek
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: An unbeaten (9-0) Niagara Top Team bantamweight from Petrolia, Ontario and former Unified MMA champion, making his UFC debut 13 months after knocking out Raphael Uchegbu on the Contender Series. A finisher who has gone five rounds twice and won, including a fifth-round calf slicer.

how_they_fight.Striking: Compact power puncher with elbows: dropped Uchegbu with an elbow in round one and finished him with an overhand right/left hook 10 seconds into round three (two knockdowns in that fight per our data). Four of his six stoppages are KO/TKOs, two are submissions.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Solid top game (5:09 of control on Uchegbu, passed to half guard and landed ground strikes); hunts submissions off his back when taken down and can reverse. Owns a calf-slicer finish (Gage Gill, R5).
how_they_fight.Defense: Was taken down once by Uchegbu and needed a fence grab to stay up early (per Cageside Press). Never been stopped or even lost a decision; untested against UFC-level wrestlers.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Finishes spread across the fight: R1 x2, R2 x2, R3 x1, R5 x1; won a five-round decision (Jordan Howard) and stopped Gill in the fifth. Pre-UFC proof he can push 25 minutes; likes to land damage late in rounds and start the next one fast (finished Uchegbu at 0:10 of R3).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Composed under adversity (recovered after being taken down in R2 vs Uchegbu). Thirteen-month gap since his last fight; no reported injury.

patterns: Elbows and hooks in close; capitalises on knockdowns with ground strikes
Comes out of the corner fast (Uchegbu finished at 0:10 of R3)
Can go five rounds; 3 of 9 wins on the cards
concerns: Step up in competition; UFC debut
13 months out since the Contender Series
Takedown defence vs a volume wrestler
Couldn't get up against a chain wrestler; the owner's note: "Cody did not so much at all" (owner's notes, UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott)
keys_to_beat: Chain wrestling and long top control
Don't engage in the pocket where his elbows and hooks live
Make him work off his back for long stretches

news.text: Debuts against Su Young You at UFC Edmonton; Heavy notes he won the Unified MMA title by fifth-round calf slicer over Gage Gill and defended it vs Jordan Howard. No reason given for the gap since DWCS.
Earned his contract by third-round KO of Raphael Uchegbu on the Contender Series; trains with Malott and Jasudavicius at Niagara Top Team.
Official weigh-in: 135.5 lb for the bantamweight bout; no misses reported on the card.
Lost to You Su-young by R3 kimura: taken down repeatedly and controlled for three rounds in his debut.
